analysis.title: Deleveraging Alert: Equity LS in US Showing Deleveraging but Buying Back Hyperscalers
key_insights: UBS's deleveraging model was active again for US Equity long/short funds on Friday, following Thursday's deleveraging alert and the degrossing of Wednesday and Thursday.
Actual flows showed US hedge funds re-grossing on Friday, driven by long buying of Hyperscalers.
The model stayed active on Friday because of its rolling lookback window, not because of new degrossing.
The crowded long-short trade continued to drift lower, but hedge fund PnL was positive on Friday.
Historically, the crowded long-short trade reverted within 5 trading days of a deleveraging.
No deleveraging is active for quants in the US, or for either strategy in Europe or Japan.
risk_factors: The deleveraging model can remain active because of its rolling lookback window even after actual flows show re-grossing, so the signal may lag flows.
